description_en: Adds mosaics, Gaussian blurs, or solid color shapes to blur one or more areas of an image for privacy protection and saves the output image to the specified path in Object Storage Service (OSS)
description_zh: 在一张图片的一个或多个特定区域内添加多种形状的马赛克、高斯模糊或纯色块，并将填充后的图片保存到指定的OSS文件对象地址。该功能主要用于隐私保护
kebab_example: aliyun imm add-image-mosaic --project-name test-project --source-uri oss://examplebucket/sampleobject.jpg --target-uri oss://examplebucket/outputImage.jpg --targets '[{"Type":"square","MosaicRadius":5,"Sigma":5,"Color":"#FFFFFF","BlurRadius":3,"Boundary":{}}]' --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddImageMosaic

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the input image.

Specify the OSS URI in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format, where `${Bucket}` is the name of the bucket in the same region as the current project and `${Object}` is the path of the object with the extension included.

Supported formats of input images include JPG, PNG, TIFF, JP2, and BMP
parameters.help_zh:
源图片的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径。

支持的图片格式：jpg，png，tiff，jp2，bmp
parameters.name: source_uri

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the output image.

Specify the OSS URI in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format, where `${Bucket}` is the name of the bucket in the same region as the current project and `${Object}` is the path of the object with the extension included
parameters.help_zh:
输出图片存储的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
parameters.name: target_uri

parameters.help_en: The encoding of the output image. By default, the output image uses the same encoding as the input image. Valid values: jpg, png, and webp
parameters.help_zh: 图片保存时的编码格式。可取值为jpg、png、webp，默认与输入图片编码格式相同
parameters.name: image_format

parameters.help_en: The quality of the output image. This parameter applies only to JPG and WebP images. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 80
parameters.help_zh: 输出图片的压缩质量，仅限jpg和webp图片格式。设置范围为0~100，默认为80
parameters.name: quality

fields.help_en:
The radius of the Gaussian blur. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 3. Unit: pixels.

This parameter takes effect only for a Gaussian blur
fields.help_zh:
高斯模糊的模糊半径，取值范围为1~50，默认值为3，单位为px。
该参数仅在添加高斯模糊时生效
fields.name: blur_radius

fields.help_en:
The height of the bounding box. The value can be an integer greater than or equal to 0 or a decimal within the range of [0,1):

An integer value greater than or equal to 0 indicates the height of the bounding box in pixels.
A decimal value within the range of [0,1) indicates the height of the bounding box as a ratio of its height to the image height
fields.help_zh:
处理框的高，不同取值的含义如下：
取值为大于等于0的整数：表示处理框高度，单位为px。
取值为小数：表示框纵向长度像素值与图片整体高度的比值，取值范围为[0,1)
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The reference position of the bounding box on the image. Valid values:

topright: the upper-right corner.
topleft: the upper-left corner. This is the default value.
bottomright: the lower-right corner.
bottomleft: the lower-left corner
fields.help_zh:
处理框在图片上的基准位置。可取值如下：
topright：右上方
topleft（默认）：左上方
bottomright：右下方
bottomleft：左下方
fields.name: refer_pos

fields.help_en:
The width of the bounding box. The value can be an integer greater than or equal to 0 or a decimal within the range of [0,1):

An integer value greater than or equal to 0 indicates the width of the bounding box in pixels.
A decimal value within the range of [0,1) indicates the width of the bounding box as a ratio of its width to the image width
fields.help_zh:
处理框的宽，不同取值的含义如下：
取值为大于等于0的整数：表示处理框宽度，单位为px。
取值为小数：表示框横向长度像素值与图片整体宽度的比值，取值范围为[0,1)
fields.name: width

fields.help_en:
The horizontal offset relative to the reference position. The value can be an integer greater than or equal to 0 or a decimal within the range of [0,1):

An integer value greater than or equal to 0 indicates the horizontal offset in pixels.
A decimal value within the range of [0,1) indicates the horizontal offset as a ratio of the offset to the image width
fields.help_zh:
处理框相较于基准点的水平偏移，不同取值的含义如下：
取值为大于等于0的整数：表示距离基准位置的横向距离，单位为px。
取值为小数：表示横向距离像素值与图片整体宽度的比值，取值范围为[0,1)
fields.name: x

fields.help_en:
The vertical offset relative to the reference position. The value can be an integer greater than or equal to 0 or a decimal within the range of [0,1):

An integer value greater than or equal to 0 indicates the vertical offset in pixels.
A decimal value within the range of [0,1) indicates the vertical offset as a ratio of the offset to the image height
fields.help_zh:
处理框相较于基准点的垂直偏移，不同取值的含义如下：
取值为大于等于0的整数：表示距离基准位置的纵向距离，单位为px。
取值为小数：表示纵向距离像素值与图片整体高度的比值，取值范围为[0,1)
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The position of the bounding box
fields.name: boundary

fields.help_en:
The color of the color shape. You can specify a color by using a color code such as`#RRGGBB` or preset color names such as `red` and `white`. The default value is #FFFFFF, which is white.

This parameter takes effect only for solid color shapes
fields.help_zh:
纯色块的颜色，支持`#FFFFFF`形式与预设的`red`、`white`等关键字。默认值为#FFFFFF，即白色。
该参数仅在添加纯色块时生效
fields.name: color

fields.help_en:
The radius of the mosaic. Default value: 5. Unit: pixels.

This parameter does not take effect for Gaussian blurs and solid color shapes
fields.help_zh:
马赛克小块的半径大小。默认值为5，单位为px。
该参数对于添加高斯模糊与纯色块不生效
fields.name: mosaic_radius

fields.help_en:
The standard deviation of the Gaussian blur. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 5.

This parameter takes effect only for a Gaussian blur
fields.help_zh:
高斯模糊的标准差，取值必须大于0，默认值为5。

该参数仅在添加高斯模糊时生效
fields.name: sigma

fields.help_en:
The type of the mosaic effect. Valid values:

square: squares.
diamond: diamonds.
hexagon: hexagons.
blur: Gaussian blurs.
pure: solid color shapes
fields.help_zh:
添加的马赛克类型。可取值如下：
square：方形的马赛克
diamond：菱形的马赛克
hexagon：正六边形的马赛克
blur：高斯模糊
pure：纯色块
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The bounding boxes and processing parameters
parameters.help_zh: 处理框及操作类别参数数组
parameters.name: targets

fields.help_en: The ID of the account that you use to grant permissions
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The RAM role that can be assumed
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:

user: Alibaba Cloud account.
service: Alibaba Cloud service
fields.help_zh:
角色类型，可选值如下。
user：阿里云账号。
service：阿里云服务
fields.name: role_type

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
fields.name: chain

fields.help_en: The policy that is attached to the role specified by the ServiceRole parameter. For example, the policy allows access to OSS. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: ServiceRole参数的角色所需配置的权限策略，例如允许访问OSS。可选
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The service role in the account that is used to call an IMM API operation. The role must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You can configure permissions for the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console
fields.help_zh: 服务角色，调用IMM接口的账号需要创建的一个角色，必须包含 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行配置
fields.name: service_role

parameters.help_en:
If you do not have special requirements, leave this parameter empty.

The authorization chain settings. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.help_zh:
如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可。

链式授权配置，非必填。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.name: credential_config
